"The strip" is the element with data-testid "message-gitinfo" whose text contains {{HASH}}. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. The Open Diff link's href must contain "cwd=" followed by encodeURIComponent("{{REPO}}") (compare in an eval). Then check the layout in the light theme and then in the dark one: 7.
